changelog.name: Niagara Private Space 0.1.0
changelog.body:
First release.

### Private apps in Niagara
Niagara can already store, show and launch private apps in favorites, folders and pop-ups; it only blocks them in its menus and app pickers. This module lifts that block and hides private apps again while Private Space is locked:
- A private app's long-press menu offers what a work app's offers (Favorite, Edit pop-up and so on)
- The pickers for favorites, folders, pop-ups, Niagara-button actions, music apps, hidden apps, Leisure Apps and the notification summary list private apps
- Suggestions, app shortcuts and the Add shortcut screen include private apps
- While Private Space is locked, its apps are hidden from the home page, from folders and pop-ups (which show "Unlock Private Space to see your apps" instead) and from the pickers' lists of chosen apps. Nothing stored is removed
- Tapping a locked private app (the Niagara button, for example) brings up Android's unlock screen and opens the app once Private Space is unlocked
- If a Niagara update means the module no longer recognises the code it changes, it changes nothing and tells you once per Niagara version, with a tip on Niagara's home page (or a Toast)

There is no settings screen, no toggle and no launcher icon: the module is on when Niagara is in its scope.

### Requirements
- Vector v2.2 or newer (libxposed API 101+)
- Android 15 or newer
- Niagara Launcher, with apps in Android's built-in Private Space

Built against Niagara 1.16.32 (1638). On a phone (Android 17), only the long-press menu and the favorites editor's list have been checked so far.

Source: https://github.com/crankshift/niagara-private-space/releases/tag/1-0.1.0

readme:
# Niagara Private Space

An Xposed module for [Niagara Launcher](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=bitpit.launcher) that lets it place **private apps** (apps in Android's Private Space) the way it places personal apps: in favorites, in folders and pop-ups, and as Niagara-button actions.

Full description, source and issue tracker: [crankshift/niagara-private-space](https://github.com/crankshift/niagara-private-space).

## What it does

Niagara can already store, show and launch private apps in all those places. It only blocks them in its menus and app pickers. This module lifts that block, and hides private apps again while Private Space is locked. It is written against Niagara 1.16.32's code and checked by unit tests; only part of it has run on a phone yet.

- A private app's long-press menu offers what a work app's offers (Favorite, Edit pop-up and so on).
- The pickers for favorites, folders, pop-ups, Niagara-button actions, music apps, hidden apps, Leisure Apps and the notification summary list private apps.
- Suggestions, app shortcuts and the Add shortcut screen include private apps.
- While Private Space is locked, its apps are hidden from the home page, from folders and pop-ups (which show "Unlock Private Space to see your apps" instead) and from the pickers' lists of chosen apps. Nothing stored is removed.
- Tapping a locked private app (the Niagara button, for example) brings up Android's unlock screen and opens the app once Private Space is unlocked.
- If a Niagara update means the module no longer recognises the code it changes, it changes nothing, and tells you once per Niagara version with a tip on Niagara's home page (or a Toast).

There is no settings screen, no toggle and no launcher icon: the module is on when Niagara is in its scope.

## Requirements

- Root and [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/releases) v2.2 or newer (libxposed API 101+). The original LSPosed is not supported.
- Android 15 or newer, with Niagara Launcher using Android's built-in Private Space (not Samsung Secure Folder or other vendor vaults).

Last tested Niagara version: 1.16.32 (1638), on Android 17, for the long-press menu and the favorites editor's list only. The rest has not run on a phone yet.

## Install

### With Obtainium

[![Get it on Obtainium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/main/assets/graphics/badge_obtainium.png)](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22io.github.crankshift.niagaraprivatespace%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FXposed-Modules-Repo%2Fio.github.crankshift.niagaraprivatespace%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22crankshift%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Niagara%20Private%20Space%22%2C%22preferredApkIndex%22%3A0%2C%22additionalSettings%22%3A%22%7B%5C%22versionExtractionRegEx%5C%22%3A%5C%22%5E%5C%5C%5C%5Cd%2B-%28.%2B%29%24%5C%22%2C%5C%22matchGroupToUse%5C%22%3A%5C%22%241%5C%22%2C%5C%22versionDetection%5C%22%3Atrue%2C%5C%22apkFilterRegEx%5C%22%3A%5C%22%5C%5C%5C%5C.apk%24%5C%22%2C%5C%22about%5C%22%3A%5C%22Xposed%20module%20that%20lets%20Niagara%20Launcher%20place%20private%20apps%20in%20favorites%2C%20folders%20and%20pop-ups.%5C%22%7D%22%7D)

### By hand

1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.crankshift.niagaraprivatespace/releases/latest) and download the APK.
2. Tap the downloaded file and allow the install.

Once the store has caught up with a release (about 8 days), the module is also listed in the module repository built into Vector.

## Enable

1. Open the Vector manager, find **Niagara Private Space** in the module list and switch it on.
2. Open the module's scope and tick Niagara (`bitpit.launcher`).
3. Force-stop Niagara and open it again.

## License

[GPL-3.0](https://github.com/crankshift/niagara-private-space/blob/main/LICENSE). Not affiliated with Niagara Launcher.
readmeZh:
# 尼亚加拉私人空间

[Niagara Launcher](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=bitpit.launcher) 的 Xposed 模块，可以按照放置个人应用程序的方式放置**私人应用程序**（Android 私人空间中的应用程序）：在收藏夹中、在文件夹和弹出窗口中以及作为 Niagara 按钮操作。

完整描述、来源和问题跟踪器：[crankshift/niagara-private-space](https://github.com/crankshift/niagara-private-space)。

## 它的作用

Niagara 已经可以在所有这些地方存储、显示和启动私人应用程序。它只会在菜单和应用程序选择器中阻止它们。该模块解除了该障碍，并在私人空间被锁定时再次隐藏私人应用程序。它是针对 Niagara 1.16.32 的代码编写的，并通过单元测试进行检查；目前只有部分内容可以在手机上运行。

- 私人应用程序的长按菜单提供工作应用程序提供的内容（收藏夹、编辑弹出窗口等）。
- 收藏夹、文件夹、弹出窗口、Niagara 按钮操作、音乐应用程序、隐藏应用程序、休闲应用程序和通知摘要列表私人应用程序的选择器。
- 建议、应用程序快捷方式和添加快捷方式屏幕包括私人应用程序。
- 当私人空间被锁定时，其应用程序将从主页、文件夹和弹出窗口（显示“解锁私人空间以查看您的应用程序”）以及所选应用程序的选择器列表中隐藏。存储的任何内容都不会被删除。
- 点击锁定的私人应用程序（例如 Niagara 按钮）会弹出 Android 的解锁屏幕，并在私人空间解锁后打开该应用程序。
- 如果 Niagara 更新意味着模块不再识别其更改的代码，则它不会更改任何内容，并在每个 Niagara 版本上通过 Niagara 主页（或 Toast）上的提示告诉您一次。

没有设置屏幕，没有切换开关，也没有启动器图标：当 Niagara 处于其范围内时，该模块处于打开状态。

## 要求

- Root 和 [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/releases) v2.2 或更高版本 (libxposed API 101+)。不支持原始的 LSPod。
- Android 15 或更高版本，Niagara Launcher 使用 Android 的内置私人空间（不是三星安全文件夹或其他供应商保管库）。

最后测试的 Niagara 版本：1.16.32 (1638)，Android 17，仅适用于长按菜单和收藏夹编辑器列表。其余的还没有在手机上运行。

## 安装

### 与获取

[！[开始吧获取](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/main/assets/graphics/badge_obtainium.png)](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://app/%7B%22id%22%3A%22io.github.crankshift.niagaraprivates pace%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FXposed-Modules-Repo%2Fio.github.crankshift.niagaraprivates pace%22%2C%22author%22%3A%22crankshift%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Niagara%20Private%20Space%22%2C%22preferredApkIndex %22%3A0%2C%22additionalSettings%22%3A%22%7B%5C%22versionExtractionRegEx%5C%22%3A%5C%22%5E%5C%5C%5C%5Cd%2B-%28。 %2B%29%24%5C%22%2C%5C%22matchGroupToUse%5C%22%3A%5C%22%241%5C%22%2C%5C%22versionDetection%5C%22%3Atrue%2C%5C%22 apkFilterRegEx%5C%22%3A%5C%22%5C%5C%5C%5C.apk%24%5C%22%2C%5C%22about%5C%22%3A%5C%22Xposed%20module%20that%20le ts%20Niagara%20Launcher%20place%20private%20apps%20in%20favorites%2C%20folders%20and%20pop-ups.%5C%22%7D%22%7D)

### 手工

1. 打开[最新版本](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.crankshift.niagaraprivatespace/releases/latest)并下载APK。
2. 点击下载的文件并允许安装。

一旦商店赶上发布（大约 8 天），该模块也会列在 Vector 内置的模块存储库中。

## 启用

1. 打开矢量管理器，在模块列表中找到**Niagara Private Space**并将其打开。
2. 打开模块的范围并勾选 Niagara (`bitpit.launcher`)。
3. 强行停止 Niagara 并再次打开它。

## 许可证

[GPL-3.0](https://github.com/crankshift/niagara-private-space/blob/main/LICENSE)。不隶属于 Niagara Launcher。
